title: Duplicated source is not corroboration
question: Assess whether these two reports justify escalation and explain why.

checks: Two reports share one origin and group; not two independent sources.
Expansion and differing tags alone do not establish high.
Preserve the possible impact as unconfirmed rather than inventing flight outcomes.

review.logic: Correct medium risk despite different signal tags and expanding pressure: both reports share one origin/group. It accurately explains offsets of minus 10 and plus 5 minutes, and leaves individual-flight impact unknown.
review.evidence: Citations support the shared-source analysis and actual reported vehicle queue. No unsupported historical calculations.
review.unsupportedClaims: No invented executed action, flight status or service promise.
review.proposedFacts: Not applicable: assessment response has no proposedFacts field.
notes: Some wording places the queue at the dispatch desk; the source only identifies the desk as the reporter, not the physical queue location.
The supported medium-risk conclusion is labeled assumption in one rationale item; the structured rating and explanation are otherwise consistent.
